description: DNS lookup in one call: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS and CAA records with TTLs (or just the types you ask for), NXDOMAIN status, DNSSEC validation, plus parsed hints: SPF record, CAA certificate issuers and which services the domain is verified with (TXT verification tokens). Resolved via DNS-over-HTTPS. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).

types.description: optional comma list of A,AAAA,CNAME,MX,TXT,NS,CAA,SOA (default: all but SOA)

name: domain_dns
